source.title: The New York Times warns photographers not to update Photoshop over AI features
source.author: rmason

title.zh: Photoshop 2027：纽约时报要求摄影师暂缓更新
title.en: Photoshop 2027: NYT Tells Photographers to Hold Off

excerpt.zh: Photoshop 2027 的 AI 功能可能在照片元数据中留下相关标记。纽约时报要求供稿摄影师暂不使用该版本，以避免编辑记录引发误解。
excerpt.en: Photoshop 2027 may add AI-related metadata to edited photos. The New York Times has told freelance photographers to avoid the update while the effects of specific tools remain unclear.

disclosure.zh: 本文使用星期天AI中转站大模型，基于 Hacker News 内容自动生成。
disclosure.en: This article was automatically generated by the Weekly Day AI gateway model using content from Hacker News.

text.zh: Photoshop 2027 的 AI 功能引发了新闻摄影流程方面的顾虑。据《The Verge》报道，纽约时报要求为该报工作的自由摄影师，在执行任务时避免使用 Photoshop 2027（28.0.0 版及后续更新）。
text.en: Photoshop 2027's AI features have raised concerns about newsroom photography workflows. The New York Times has told freelance photographers working on assignment for the paper to avoid version 28.0.0 and subsequent updates, according to The Verge.

text.zh: 该报摄影负责人在邮件中表示，部分 AI 功能的使用方式可能不易被用户察觉，并可能导致照片元数据标示图像由 AI 生成或经 AI 编辑。Adobe 正在其应用中支持 C2PA 元数据，用于表明图像是否由 AI 生成，或是否使用了 AI 功能进行编辑。
text.en: In an email, the paper's photography leaders said some AI features may be used in ways that are not apparent to users and could cause photo metadata to identify an image as AI-generated or AI-edited. Adobe has been rolling out C2PA metadata support in its apps to indicate whether an image was generated or edited using AI features.

text.zh: 这对《纽约时报》尤其重要，因为该报表示，照片只会进行有限的色彩调整，以确保准确呈现图像；它也称不会修饰或以数字方式操纵照片。若元数据对后期处理作出过于笼统的描述，读者可能难以分辨常规调整与生成式改动，进而影响对新闻图片的信任。
text.en: The distinction matters to the Times, which says it makes only minimal color adjustments to reproduce images accurately and does not retouch or digitally manipulate photographs. If metadata describes post-production too broadly, readers may not be able to distinguish routine adjustments from generative changes, potentially affecting trust in news photos.

text.zh: 具体受影响工具仍未明确
text.en: Which Photoshop tools are affected remains unclear

text.zh: 2027 年 11 月更新加入 AI Assisted Editor、AI 助手、提示词图像编辑、AI 放大和自动重构画布等功能；但报道没有指出时报担忧的是哪项工具。Adobe 当时尚未回应《The Verge》的置评请求，因此目前无法判断哪些功能会触发相关标记，或是否有不影响日常编辑的替代流程。
text.en: The November 2027 update adds an AI Assisted Editor, an AI assistant, prompt-based image editing, AI upscaling, and automated reframing for different canvas sizes. But the report does not identify which tools prompted the Times' restriction. Adobe had not responded to The Verge's request for comment, leaving open which features trigger the metadata and whether photographers can use an alternative workflow without changing routine edits.
